show_calendar.description: Whether the calendar should be shown (1/0).

show_timezones.description: Whether time zone clocks should be shown (1/0).

mark_today.description: Whether today's date is marked in the calendar (1/0).

show_week_numbers.description: Whether week numbers are shown in the calendar (1/0).

close_on_unfocus.description: Whether the calendar closes when losing focus (1/0).

close_on_mouseleave.description: Whether the calendar closes when mouse leaves the window (1/0).

external_viewer.description: Command to run on date double-click; shell-expanded with strftime tokens.

force_lang.description: Override LANG for locale-specific settings (e.g., first day of week).

mainwindow_decorated.description: Whether the window should be decorated by the window manager (1/0).

mainwindow_keep_above.description: Whether the window stays on top (1/0).

mainwindow_sticky.description: Whether the window is sticky across desktops (1/0).

mainwindow_skip_taskbar.description: Whether the window is hidden from the taskbar (1/0).

mainwindow_resizable.description: Whether the window should be resizable (1/0).

mainwindow_position.description: Initial window placement: 'mouse', 'center', or 'none'. Defaults to 'mouse'.

mainwindow_xoffset.description: Horizontal pixel offset from computed position.

mainwindow_yoffset.description: Vertical pixel offset from computed position.

clocks.description: List of timezone clock definitions. Each entry provides a label and optional timezone. If tz is omitted or empty, local time is shown.
